description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSerializer' providing base functionality for HTTP message serialization and deserialization, including methods for reading lines from streams, splitting headers and body, and serializing headers.

classes.name: AbstractSerializer
classes.description: Provides base functionality for request and response serialization strategies, including line retrieval, header splitting, and header serialization.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Retrieves a single line from the stream, handling CRLF sequences and throwing exceptions on malformed input.

methods.name: splitStream
methods.description: Splits a stream into headers and body content, returning headers as an array and the body as a RelativeStream.

methods.name: serializeHeaders
methods.description: Serializes headers array into a string suitable for HTTP message headers.

methods.name: filterHeader
methods.description: Converts header names to proper word case with hyphen separation.
